title: Deep catastrophic-risk-aware reinforcement learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating extreme risk in reinforcement learning becomes increasingly difficult as the confidence level increases, since only a small number of observations contribute to empirical estimates of Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). In this paper, we extend an Extreme Value Theory (EVT) approach for CVaR optimization to high-dimensional neural-network policies. Using a peaks-over-threshold representation and method-of-moments estimation, we obtain a differentiable tail-risk objective and show that, conditional on the selected threshold, its finite-sample gradient can be computed directly through automatic differentiation. We first validate the approach in a controlled experiment with a known optimal solution and then investigate its performance in a deep-hedging problem with rare extreme market movements. translated_title: 深度灾难性风险感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 在强化学习中，随着置信水平的升高，极端风险的估计变得越来越困难，因为只有少量观测值会对条件风险价值（CVaR）的经验估计有所贡献。在本文中，我们将一种用于CVaR优化的极值理论（EVT）方法扩展到高维神经网络策略。利用超阈值表示法和矩估计方法，我们得到了一个可微的尾部风险目标，并证明在选定阈值的条件下，其有限样本梯度可以通过自动微分直接计算。我们首先在一个具有已知最优解的受控实验中验证了该方法，随后在一个包含罕见极端市场波动的深度对冲问题中研究了其性能。我们的结果表明，在正常条件下，EVT训练的策略与经验CVaR训练的策略表现出相似的对冲行为，而EVT训练的策略在应对极端情况时……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将极值理论方法扩展至深度强化学习，提出了一种基于自动微分的可微尾部风险目标，使神经网络策略能够更准确地优化条件风险价值（CVaR），从而更好地应对罕见极端风险。
en_tdlr: This paper extends an Extreme Value Theory approach to deep reinforcement learning, deriving a differentiable tail-risk objective computable via automatic differentiation, enabling neural-network policies to optimize CVaR more accurately in the presence of rare extreme events.
